Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results by conflating the BBC Overseas Sports Personality of the Year with the main BBC Sports Personality of the Year award, incorrectly concluding that Muhammad Ali (3) held the record. The correct main award record holder is Andy Murray (3), whose brother is Jamie Murray. This category mix-up led the process toward the wrong person and thus the wrong brother.
